notes.title: 0.8.2.demo
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Increased overall difficulty. Bosses have more life and deal more damage, as do regular monsters.
[*] Adjusted temperature effects to be more effective against high-life enemies. Fire and Cold now scale better with each instance. Some items have been updated to balance this improvement. Enemies using temperature-based skills are now more dangerous.
[*] Nerfed Necronomicon: it now has a 4-second longer cooldown. Also fixed an issue where minions were casting items 40% faster than the player. Minions now cast 20% slower than the player.
[*] Charon's Obol appears more frequently in level-up rewards. Tooltips have been added for each prefix to explain the powers they grant to items.
[*] Roll now uses 100% mana, making it more punishing to spam non-stop.
[*] Clarified all upgrade Obol tooltips to show that they increase stats rather than grant them.
[*] Player armor is now shown near the life orb.
[*] Player temperature is now shown inside the life orb.
[*] Target enemy temperature is now displayed in the top UI.
[*] Jar now casts adjacent items 80% faster compared to the user.
[*] Reduced life gain per level from 6 to 4.
[*] Chef Hat cooldown increased by 2 seconds.
[*] Level-up rewards now show which item will be upgraded.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where player temperature reset to 0 on respawn.
[*] Fixed tooltips not updating in level-up rewards or backpack.
[*] Fixed Shatter to correctly display player life as 0.
[*] Fixed Tunic casting Blizzard off-center.
[*] Fixed item upgrade tooltips not updating.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could level up on death.
[*] Fixed Fire explanation.
[/list]
